title: Bravo Teases 'The Real Housewives Ultimate Girls Trip: Roaring 20th' With First Look Video
text:
The Real Housewives franchise is turning 20, and Bravo is celebrating with The Real Housewives Ultimate Girls Trip: Roaring 20th.
Megan Stalter Is Open To A ‘Hacks’ Spinoff & Praises “Beautiful Ending”: “It Couldn’t Have Ended Any Other Way”‘The Hunting Wives’ Cast Tease More “Naughtiness” For Season 2: “There’s A Lot More Of Everything”During the 2026 Las Culturistas Culture Awards, the network aired its first promo for the special celebrating two decades of the iconic franchise.
Vicki Gunvalson, Kyle Richards, Porsha Williams, Lisa Barlow, and Teresa Giudice are the core group who will embark on a road trip visiting‘The Hunting Wives’ Cast Tease More “Naughtiness” For Season 2: “There’s A Lot More Of Everything” The series will also feature appearances by dozens of additional Housewives, with stops in Orange County, Beverly Hills, Atlanta, Miami, and New York City, from across cities and eras, joining familiar faces in both emotional and unexpected ways as new relationships and dynamics unfold along the way.
